feeds.title: Sheppard Mullin » Law of the Ledger
feeds.description: Law of the Ledger provides analysis in legal issues related to the blockchain technology and digital currency sphere.

feeds.title: Proskauer » Blockchain and the Law
feeds.description: Blockchain and the Law is written by attorneys in the Blockchain Group of Proskauer Rose LLP, covering trending legal, regulatory and business topics that affect how companies and individuals can capitalize on the emergence of blockchain technology.

feeds.title: Stanford Journal of Blockchain Law & Policy
feeds.description: The first law journal to publish on the greater blockchain technology space. It is a part of the Stanford CodeX Blockchain Group and Stanford Center for Blockchain Research. Our scope spans (but is not limited to) the legal aspects of blockchains and cryptocurrencies, regulatory and policy ramifications, governance, and the future of decentralization.

feeds.title: Bull Blockchain Law Blog
feeds.description: On Bull Blockchain Law Blog, our lawyers produce memoranda that alert our clients to legal and regulatory developments, industry issues, and court decisions and analyze the impact of these developments on our clients. Our legal services are rooted in our passion for blockchain, and ensuring we preserve the highest standard for our clients is paramount.

feeds.title: Blockchain Technology Lab Blog
feeds.description: Blockchain Technology Lab Blog shares the latest conversations, stories, and opinions of the Blockchain Technology Lab. BTL is based at the University of Edinburgh and aims at studying all aspects of distributed ledger technology.

feeds.title: Addison Cameron-Huff Blog
feeds.description: I'm Addison Cameron-Huff, founders and management teams hire me to bring new products to market in the cryptocurrency industry. Clients know our work together is informed by experience working with some of the best in the industry. On my blog, you can read all the latest news on cryptocurrency, and the industry!

feeds.title: Overheard on the Block(chain
feeds.description: Overheard on the Block(chain) is written by the Blockchain group at Greenberg Traurig providing updates on international blockchain matters. Greenberg Traurig's global Blockchain & Digital Assets Group comprises more than 100 attorneys across multiple legal disciplines in key financial hubs around the world, providing a centralized approach to blockchain and digital asset matters.

feeds.title: Orrick Blog » Blockchain & Virtual Currency
feeds.description: Orrick's On the Chain blog helps the market stay on top of trends and issues shaping the blockchain and cryptocurrency industry globally, such as changing securities and commodities laws, the Bank Secrecy Act, OFAC statutes, IRS tax law enforcement & EU law related to fintech, bitcoin & ethereum. Orrick is a global law firm focused on serving the Technology & Innovation, Energy & Infrastructure and Finance sectors.

feeds.title: Hunton » Blockchain Legal Resource
feeds.description: Our Blockchain Legal Resource Blog features opinions and legal analysis as we follow the development and use of blockchain. Hunton Andrews Kurth provides information and commentary on how this technology will transform business practice and educate our readers on how best to the incorporation blockchain into critical business processes.

feeds.title: Steptoe » Blockchain
feeds.description: The Steptoe Blockchain Blog features opinions and analysis on laws related to cryptocurrency, crypto-assets, and blockchain technology.

feeds.title: Winston & Strawn Blog » Non-Fungible Insights: Blockchain Decrypted
feeds.description: Winston & Strawn's Non-Fungible Insights: Blockchain Decrypted blog tracks and provides user-friendly explanations of legal and regulatory developments related to blockchain technology including cryptocurrency, NFTs, and smart contracts. We've served as a trusted adviser and advocate for clients across virtually every industry. In that time, through careful growth and thoughtful fiscal management, we have built a law practice with tremendous breadth and a global reach.

feeds.title: Snell & Wilmer » Blockchain Technology and Digital Currency
feeds.description: Our Snell & Wilmer team posts updates and news about the opportunities and challenges companies face regarding blockchain technology and digital currencies. We're a full-service business law firm, that represents clients ranging from large, publicly traded corporations to small businesses, individuals, and entrepreneurs.
